name: bingo-go
description: Independent desktop workbench compatible with bingo
author: T-meow <T-meow@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.package:win: npm run reset:package-output && npm run build:bingo && npm run build && npm run prepare:bingo && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:package
scripts.package:win:unpacked: npm run reset:package-output && npm run build:bingo:win && npm run build && npm run prepare:bingo && electron-builder --dir --win --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:package
scripts.package:mac: npm run reset:package-output && npm run build:bingo && npm run build && npm run prepare:bingo && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:package
scripts.package:linux: npm run reset:package-output && npm run build:bingo && npm run build && npm run prepare:bingo && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:package
